title: Process Payment Transactions in Arrival Order
real_world_story: A payment gateway receives multiple transactions at the same time. To ensure fair processing, transactions must be handled in the same order in which they were received.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Transactions arriving at the payment gateway
real_world_connection.target_represents: The transaction that should be processed next
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Using First-In-First-Out queue operations to process transactions in arrival order

problem_statement: Given a sequence of payment queue operations, process the transactions using FIFO behavior. An ENQUEUE operation adds a transaction to the rear of the queue, while a DEQUEUE operation processes and removes the transaction at the front.
task: Process all payment transaction operations and print the transaction ID removed by each DEQUEUE operation.
input_format: The first line contains an integer Q, the number of queue operations. Each of the next Q lines contains either 'ENQUEUE X' to add transaction X to the queue or 'DEQUEUE' to process the front transaction.
output_format: For every DEQUEUE operation, print the processed transaction ID on a separate line. If the queue is empty, print -1.

examples.input:
6
ENQUEUE 101
ENQUEUE 102
DEQUEUE
ENQUEUE 103
DEQUEUE
DEQUEUE
examples.explanation: Transactions are processed in the same order in which they entered the payment queue.
The second DEQUEUE occurs when the queue is empty, so -1 is printed.

expected_algorithm.name: Queue Operations
expected_algorithm.reason: A queue follows FIFO ordering, making it suitable for processing payment transactions in the order in which they arrive.

hint: Maintain a queue of incoming transaction IDs.
Add each transaction to the rear during ENQUEUE.
Remove the transaction from the front during DEQUEUE.
Return -1 when a DEQUEUE operation is attempted on an empty queue.
real_world_takeaway: Queue operations help payment gateways process transactions fairly and reliably according to their arrival order.
